name: preadv2
synopsis: ssize_t preadv2(int fd, const struct iovec *iov, int iovcnt, off_t offset, int flags);
description: The preadv2() system call reads data into multiple buffers from the file descriptor fd at the specified offset, with additional flags to modify behavior. It combines the functionality of readv() and pread(2), performing atomic reads similar to readv().

parameters.name: iov
parameters.description: Array of iovec structures describing the buffers to fill

parameters.name: iovcnt
parameters.description: Number of elements in the iov array

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: File offset at which the read operation is performed

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that modify the behavior of the read operation

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The sum of the iov_len values overflows an ssize_t value
The vector count iovcnt is less than zero or greater than the permitted maximum
An unknown flag is specified in flags

bugs: Linux 5.9 and Linux 5.10 have a bug where preadv2() with the RWF_NOWAIT flag may return 0 even when not at end of file.
